audit.whatIsWrong: The page rates this TRICKY 7/10 while content.mid calls it 'one of the most one-sided mid-lane matchups in the pool' — and the real win rate is 50.47% over 1,373 games.
audit.why: Both cannot be true. Satchel Charge knocks you out of a committed combo on a 20s timer and Hexplosive Minefield slows every approach, which is why the lane sits near even rather than one-sided.
audit.corrected: The 'one-sided' claim replaced in content.mid with the actual reason the lane stays close; the 7/10 rating left as is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Ziggs/Ziggs/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while content win[] and the packet chart both read Diana on all seven rows. Separately, content.mid claimed Moonfall pulls him 'in from range'.
audit.why: Every phases[].why already describes Diana winning the stage, so the sides were stale. Moonfall's range is 475 — it is a short-range pull that follows your dash, it does not create the engage.
audit.corrected: All seven sides moved to Diana (win[] already Diana, no disagreement created); the range claim corrected in content.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Satchel Charge knocks Ziggs away too (his repositioning tool, not just a knockback on you), nor that Short Fuse is the auto-attack tell that his combo is starting.
audit.why: Riot's text: the explosion knocks enemies away and 'Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage'. Short Fuse periodically empowers his next basic attack and its cooldown drops whenever he casts.
audit.corrected: Both now in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1] and breakdown.carry.

audit.why: 'Catchable only while it is down' is unusable without the 20s-to-12s number.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge 20s/12s, Hexplosive Minefield flat 16s, Bouncing Bomb 6s to 4s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dosFull[2].d cited a 'fifteen-second' cooldown absent from his kit.
audit.why: Bodies must match their titles and quote real numbers.
packet suspectNames flagged 'Use Satchel Charge' in wants.foe[1] — false positive, Satchel Charge is the real W name and the convention 'Satchel Charge (W)' is correct.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Pale Cascade is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — it knocks you away and it knocks him away, so he is catchable only on its downtime. - Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s of slow zone; Bouncing Bomb recycles from 6s to 4s.

edits.before: His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Crescent Strike outranges his 850 Bouncing Bomb — arc it over the wave so the Moonlight mark makes your dash free.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Pale Cascade shields as its orbs spawn — step up on that window, since his Short Fuse auto is the tell his combo is starting.

edits.before: Ziggs burns Satchel Charge on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: A Moonlight mark refunds Lunar Rush; without one it costs 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: That is Ziggs’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Unmarked, Lunar Rush is a 22s spend and Satchel Charge just knocks you back out.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Without the mark there is no reset, and his Hexplosive Minefield slows you out of range while he walks the poke back.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by satchelling you out of the combo, mining the ground you must cross, and chipping you with 4s bombs.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Satchel Charge knocks you off him even mid-dive — save Moonfall until he has spent it, then pull and finish.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 keep tilting toward Diana as her combo damage scales and her gap-close (Q-E) lets her punish his positioning more decisively, and by level 6 Moonfall completely erases his ability to kite — pulling him in from range means his kit has almost no answer once she commits. This is one of the most one-sided mid-lane matchups in the pool because Ziggs has no real disengage against a point-and-click pull.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 keep tilting toward Diana as her combo damage scales and her gap-close (Q-E) lets her punish his positioning more decisively, and by level 6 Moonfall punishes any misstep — but its 475 range means the pull follows your dash, it never replaces it. The lane still sits close to even because Satchel Charge knocks you out of the combo on a 20s timer and Hexplosive Minefield slows every approach.

notes: QUESTION-ADJACENT, decided rather than skipped: the page rates Diana/Ziggs TRICKY 7/10 with an all-Diana level chart while the real win rate is 50.47%.
